_comment: AWI Resolve agent settings. For a real customer install, set orchestratorUrl to the hosted connector (wss://connect.alphawebin.com) and enrollmentSecret to the same door key you set on the connector (fly secrets set RESOLVE_ENROLLMENT_SECRET=...). For the local demo, leave the localhost values.
_licenseKey: Paste the RSLIC1-... key issued by Create-License.cmd. Without it the machine still gets full diagnostics, but fixes and deployment are withheld.
